summary: Prevent IndexError when a block-level terminator rule reads state.src[pos] for a line where pos == len(state.src). Wrap the html check in html_block with a try/except IndexError and adjust heading to check pos < maximum before indexing. This mirrors protections used in sibling rules.
risks: Low. Changes only add a bounds check / try/except around a single character access or reorder an existing check to avoid out-of-range indexing. Behavior for normal inputs is unchanged. One small style change in heading removes an unused early ch binding; subsequent code initializes ch before use.
regression_tests:
def test_table_inside_blockquote_ending_with_marker_html_enabled():
    md = MarkdownIt().enable("table")
    # previously raised IndexError
    md.parse('> | a | b |\n> |---|---|\n>')

def test_table_inside_blockquote_ending_with_marker_html_disabled():
    md = MarkdownIt("commonmark", {"html": False}).enable("table")
    # previously raised IndexError (heading terminator)
    md.parse('> | a | b |\n> |---|---|\n>')
